ApiKey.name: x-api-key
ApiKey.description:
The API Key ID as specified in the [API settings page](https://cube.exchange/settings/api).

Each API key has a corresponding access level that is set when the key is created.
- Read access only allows access to read HTTP methods (GET, HEAD, etc.).
- Write access allows access to all HTTP methods.

ApiSignature.name: x-api-signature
ApiSignature.description:
The API signature string authenticating this request.

The payload to be signed is the concatenation of the byte string `cube.xyz` and the current unix epoch timestamp in seconds converted into an 8-byte little-endian array. The signature is the HMAC-SHA256 digest of the payload using the secret key associated with the specified API key.

Implementation notes:
- The signature is base-64 encoded with the 'standard' alphabet and
  padding.

  ```
  ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/
  ```
- The timestamp should be encoded as 8-byte little-endian (array of bytes)
- The secret key should be decoded from a hex string into a 32-byte array of
  bytes

ApiTimestamp.description: The timestamp used for signature generation.

If `txn_state` is `Confirmed` and `KytStatus` is accepted, this is the time that the

The estimated time that this deposit will transition to `Confirmed`. This is currently
 only applicable for `Received` deposits

 confirmed.
The transfer is fully confirmed on-chain.

orderId.description: The cube-assigned order ID, also known as `ExchangeOrderId`. Unique per order.

price.description:
Most recent price, including modifies.
 For StopLoss orders, this value will match what was in the request.
 e.g. if specified with no protection price, this field will be missing.
 For MarketWithProtection orders specified with no protection price,
 this value will be the exchange-defined protection price.
 For (Unmodified) MarketLimit orders, this will be the price at which the order would rest,
 which is equal to the top-of-book of the opposing side at the time the order matches.

stopPrice.description:
For Stop Orders, the stop_price specified in the most recent New or Modify request.
 For other orders, this will be unset.

qty.description:
Most recent quantity, including modifies.
 For rejects where order is specified in quote quantity, this will be zero.

quoteQty.description:
The original quote quantity of the order, if the order was
 originally specified in quote quantity.
 For orders specified in base quantity, this will be null.

createdAt.description: The matching-engine transact-time in nanoseconds that this order was created.

modifiedAt.description:
The matching-engine transact-time in nanoseconds of the most recent modify event.
 Empty if the order was never modified.

canceledAt.description:
The matching-engine transact-time in nanoseconds when this order was cancelled.
 Empty if the order was never cancelled, e.g. is open or filled.

triggeredAt.description:
The matching-engine transact-time in nanoseconds when this order was triggered
 and placed on the book.  Only applicable to Stop Orders.

modifies.description:
Any previous states of price/quantity associated with this order due to modifies.
 If the order has been modified, the original price/quantity will appear in this list.

reason.description: Reject reason if rejected. Cancel reason if canceled.

settled.description:
The settlement status for this order's fills.

 If the order has no fills, or none of the fills have been assigned to a settlement batch,
 then this will be `None`. This can be derived from `fills`.

status.description:
The current status of this order. Note that if the order is `Open`, this is a best-effort
 estimation, and the order service has the most correct status.

orderFees.description: Any fees applied to the order as a whole, which are distinct from any fees applied to each fill.

algoStrategyId.description: The ID associated with the Algo Strategy that placed this order, if any.

oneOf.description: Reified but not processed by chain before expiry (or conflicting transaction)

isAggressor.description: If this order was an aggressor in this fill.

amount.description:

 satoshis for BTC, wei for ETH, lamports for SOL). The amount must be greater than the dust
 limit for the asset.

feeAmount.description:
The requisite fee amount to be paid for a cube-sponsored withdrawal.

 This is paid from `amount`. i.e `destination` will receive `amount - fee_amount`.

 The fee amount is denominated in `asset_id`. See `withdrawal_fees`

destination.description: The destination address for the withdrawal.

signature.description: Base-64 encoded signature of this withdrawal request

KlinesParamsInterval.description:
Either an explicit interval or "auto" to derive the interval from the start
 and end times. When deriving the interval, the start time is required, and
 `limit` must be omitted (all data in the interval will be returned).

items.description:
time: the starting time of the interval that this kline represents,
 in seconds since the Unix epoch.
open: the last traded market price at the beginning of this kline's interval
high: the maximum traded market price during this kline's interval
low: the minimum traded market price during this kline's interval
close:: the minimum traded market price during this kline's interval

volume: the quantity transacted during this kline's interval,
 represented in RawUnits.

symbol.description: The canonical symbol for this asset.

decimals.description:
The maximum precision of this asset.

 e.g `18` for ETH (`10^18` WEI per ETH), `8` for BTC (`10^8` SAT per BTC)

displayDecimals.description: The default number of decimal places to display for human-readable quantities for this asset.

settles.description: Whether this asset settles to the blockchain.

params.description: If this asset is a perpetual contract, the parameters for that perpetual contract.

sourceId.description: The source ID of this asset.

underlyingAssetId.description: The asset ID of the underlying asset.

settlementAssetId.description: The asset ID of the settlement asset.

marginTierTableId.description: The ID of the margin tier table that this asset uses.

liquidationClearanceFee.description:
The fee charged during liquidation.

 Expressed as a percentage of the closed positions notional mark value.

 The total fee is equal to `closed_units * mark_price * liquidation_clearance_fee`.

liquidationPriority.description:
Priority level for liquidation processing, where lower numbers indicate higher priority

 Determines the order in which different perpetual markets are liquidated

fundingStart.description:
Unix timestamp (in seconds) when funding payments begin

 Marks the start of the first funding interval for the perpetual market

fundingPeriod.description:
Total duration of a complete funding cycle in seconds.

 A funding cycle is broken down into further intervals for funding payments. Funding rates
 are calculated based on the length of the period and then prorated for the interval.

fundingInterval.description: Time between individual funding payments in seconds.

fundingRateCalculationInterval.description: Interval in seconds between premium index recalculations.

impactBidQuantity.description:
Quantity of contracts on the bid side used for impact price calculation

 Used to measure market impact and determine fair price for funding calculations

impactAskQuantity.description:
Quantity of contracts on the ask side used for impact price calculation

 Used to measure market impact and determine fair price for funding calculations

Source.description:
A collection of assets grouped by origination.

 For `Crypto` assets, this is their native blockchain.

 e.g `ETH` and `SHIB` are both on the `ethereum` (`CHAIN_ID = 0x1`) blockchain.

name.description: A human-readable name for this source.

transactionExplorer.description:
The URL of a block explorer that can be used to view transactions.

 The value is provided as a format string with a single `{}` placeholder for the
 transaction. e.g `https://etherscan.io/tx/{}`

addressExplorer.description:
The URL of a block explorer that can be used to view addresses.

 The value is provided as a format string with a single `{}` placeholder for the
 address. e.g `https://etherscan.io/address/{}`

Market.description:
A market is identified by its unique `marketId`. The market definition specifies specifies the
 base and quote assets and their respective lot sizes for the particular market.

symbol.description:
The market's symbol. Normally this is base symbol concatenated with the quote symbol.

 e.g `BTCUSDC`

baseAssetId.description: The asset ID of the base asset.

baseLotSize.description: The number of units of the base asset that are represented by one base lot.

quoteAssetId.description: The asset ID of the quote asset.

quoteLotSize.description: The number of units of the quote asset that are represented by one quote lot.

priceDisplayDecimals.description: The default number of decimal places to display for human-readable prices for this market.

priceBandBidPct.description: The percentage that a new bid can be placed below the current reference price.

priceBandAskPct.description: The percentage that a new ask can be placed above the current reference price.

minOrderQuoteAmt.description:
The minimum notional amount for which an order will be accepted,
 expressed in RawUnits of the quote asset.  Inclusive.
 Note that this value is price-dependent.

maxOrderQuoteAmt.description:
The maximum notional amount for which an order will be accepted,
 expressed in RawUnits of the quote asset.  Inclusive.
 Note that this value is price-dependent.

feeTableId.description: ID of the fee table that will be used for lookups on this market.

baseMarketIds.description:
If this is an implied market, this is the list of implied-through base markets. Otherwise,
 this is `None`.

isImplied.description:
If this market is currently enabled for implied matching, this will be `true`.
 Otherwise, this will be `false` or missing.

impliedScheme.description:
The implied scheme for this market.
 eg.
 If BsQs scheme, given assets ETH, BTC, and USDC, and let B be ETH, S be USDC, and Q be BTC
 then given base markets ETH/USDC and BTC/USDC, we can have implied market ETH/BTC.

FeeTable.description:
A fee table consisting of one or more fee tiers.
 Each tier is applied in priority order
 and the first tier whose requirements match the characteristics of a given fill
 determines the fees for that fill.
 Each market is associated with a specific fee table via its "feeTableId".

FeeTier.description: A single row in a FeeTable.

priority.description: The order in which this tier is considered when applying the fee table that contains it.

makerFeeRatio.description: The multiplicative fee ratio for the resting order

takerFeeRatio.description: The multiplicative fee ratio for the aggressing order

MarginTable.description:
The margin table defines the pro-rated (tiered) margin requirements for various position sizes.

 The margin requirement is the sum of the maintenance margin rate multiplied by the portion of
 notional size within each tier.

defaultLeverage.description:
The default leverage for this margin table.

 Used if there is no leverage override configured for a subaccount.

MarginTier.description: A single row in a MarginTable.

maxLeverage.description: The maximum leverage that can be used in this margin tier.

maintenanceMarginRate.description: The maintenance margin rate for this margin tier.

liquidatorFee.description:
The percentage of the maintenance margin requirement received for providing backstop
 liquidity when liquidating a position.

 Expressed as a percentage of the backstopped position's maintenance margin.

   `maintenance_margin_required(backstopped_units * mark_price) * liquidator_fee`

minAmount.description: The minimum amount that can be withdrawn through gas-sponsored withdrawals.

feeAmount.description:
The fee in units of `asset_id` that will be charged for a gas-sponsored withdrawal.

 This covers the cost of gas to relay the withdrawal transaction.
